### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/verify`, touching **32** documentable anchor(s).

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d6b88f19f5bf9df334fa6ee95c5f88c67f7943a3`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `PERMISSION_DENIED (literal, 51 pages)`
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **21** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d6b88f19f5bf9df334fa6ee95c5f88c67f7943a3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b5e6d04c89b4d3261874cc3819922b0417a9a25f` — the merge of head `5fe5cdb46222e16b232765d98f8bfafd1448b653` into base `d6b88f19f5bf9df334fa6ee95c5f88c67f7943a3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b5e6d04c89b4d3261874cc3819922b0417a9a25f && git checkout b5e6d04c89b4d3261874cc3819922b0417a9a25f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d6b88f19f5bf9df334fa6ee95c5f88c67f7943a3 5fe5cdb46222e16b232765d98f8bfafd1448b653 && git checkout -B drift-repro d6b88f19f5bf9df334fa6ee95c5f88c67f7943a3 && git merge --no-ff 5fe5cdb46222e16b232765d98f8bfafd1448b653

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d6b88f19f5bf9df334fa6ee95c5f88c67f7943a3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d6b88f19f5bf9df334fa6ee95c5f88c67f7943a3` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `5fe5cdb46222e16b232765d98f8bfafd1448b653`
Local-runs: none

The face is the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone. The PR's file list carries no `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path, so `TIER_DEFAULT` by the lane seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@objectstack/verify` public surface (widened, correct).** `ParentWriteReachReach` is re-exported from the package entry (`packages/verify/src/index.ts`). `masters` gains `'none'`, `masterRead` gains `'none'`, and an optional `unreadableDetails?: ParentWriteReachOwner[]` is added. All of it is additive on a report (output) type. Its only producer and renderer is `parent-write-reach.ts`, which the PR updates. No in-repo source outside `packages/verify` names the type (a `git grep` at this head finds only CHANGELOG lines; the control is that `index.ts` itself hits).
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security` accept set (widened at runtime, ruled).** A write on a `controlled_by_parent` row whose optional master is empty was refused `422 MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD`. Now an insert is admitted under the detail's own create grant, and an update or delete is admitted to the row's owner or a Modify All holder on the detail (`hasSuperuserWriteBypass`, the `modify` bit). Everyone else gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` on the `master_chain` leg. The by-id path, each null-master row a predicate write selects, the chain hop, and both on-behalf-of passes (per the PR's tests) all reach the one rule, `nullMasterRowWritable`. This runtime permission change is the human-floor class; the maintainer ruled it (「A」, quoted in #30906's body).
- **Card item 4 holds.** A body that empties an optional master skips the `ownerMayEdit` leg (`!(rel.optional && bodyEmptiesMasterReference(...))`) and takes the §3 walk on the stored master.
- **Accepted deviation, stricter than the card.** null → M first asks the row's owner rule, then edit on M. Card item 3 asks only the new master. The extra leg stops a non-owner from attaching someone's private row to a master, and it narrows; it never widens.
- **No new published name in `plugin-security`.** `CbpPredicateWriteSelection` lives in `security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts`, which `src/index.ts` does not re-export (zero hits; the control `export` has 42 hits in that file). `ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite` returns existing union members only.
- **Required masters unchanged.** The new branches are all guarded by `rel.optional`, and the #9137 frozen branch is untouched.

### ② Semver level

`minor` for both `@objectstack/plugin-security` and `@objectstack/verify` (`.changeset/30906-cbp-null-master-write-gate.md`). That matches an additive output-type widening and a ruled runtime admission. No `!`, no `(narrowing)` arm.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev Q1 (which denial leg): the seat answers A, keep `master_chain`, no spec change.
- Dev Q2 (where the ADR-0055 §3 amendment lands): the seat answers A, it rides #30907 (carry-over comment on #30907).
- Spec jsdoc of `master_reference_missing` / `master_chain` does not name the optional master: an Acceptance note, carried by #30907 (spec-lane routing named there).
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay): no off-relay write.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-30906-null-master-write-gate`
Reviewed-by: `session_017xRBcTJTE7kSbcMoJQ4Txf`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · Head-sha `5fe5cdb46222e16b232765d98f8bfafd1448b653` · read at 2026-11-07T04:29Z

- **Shape.** Draft into `main`. The body opens `Fixes #30906`, then `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: semantic` and `Skills-docs: follow-up #30907`. The changeset carries the same three lines. No other open card number sits beside a closing keyword. 8 files, +1037/−54: the changeset, `plugin-security` (`security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts`, `security-plugin.ts`, `explain-engine.ts`, `security-plugin-cbp-relation.ts` comment-only, the optional-master test) and `verify` (`parent-write-reach.ts` and its test). All are inside the claim's file surface as corrected in 6701304837.
- **Premise measured.** On `origin/main` before dispatch, a null optional master threw `MasterReferenceMissingError` on the create, update and predicate paths. The dev confirmed step 2.7 hands the floor to this gate, so the rule lives in the gate.
- **Gate check-runs on this head.** 37 success and 15 skipped, none failed or pending. `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` both succeeded. `mergeable_state` is `clean`. `check-governed-merges --pr 31082`: NOT governed, 1091 lines ≤ 3000.
- **Accepted deviations.**
  - null → M asks the row's owner rule before edit on M (stricter than card item 3).
  - `explain-engine.ts` narrates the null-master refusal.
  - The dev left the PR assignee and the post-create body to the seat (the seat patched the body for the `Clause-②` correction).
  - Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's; `Lint · ESLint` succeeded on this head.
- **Out-of-scope dispositions.**
  - ADR-0055 §3 amendment → #30907 (carry-over comment there).
  - Spec jsdoc of `master_reference_missing` / `master_chain` → #30907, spec-lane routing named there (Acceptance note, not a three-class card).
  - Stale `omissionRefusedByValidation` comment → fixed in this PR.
  - `Skills-docs: follow-up #30907` is true: that card exists, is open, and is `pm:blocked` on this one.
- **Landing clause.** The contract review record 6702137573 (`TIER_DEFAULT`, PASS) is on this same head. Not governed, so: ready, then auto-merge. `Fixes #30906` closes the card on merge, and the seat strips `pm:dispatched` in the same stroke as the landing note. Then #30907's `Blocked-by: #30906` is due for its unblock scan.

Spot checks of the diff: refusals assert `code` + `status` + `details{operation,object,recordId}` (the real-engine block of `controlled-by-parent-optional-master.test.ts`). The owner rule's ablation reads 10 red when it is forced to `true`, per the dev's run log in the PR body. The changeset's sentences match the gate diff (create admitted; update and delete by the owner or Modify All, `403` otherwise; emptying asks the stored master and is not covered by `ownerMayEdit`; required masters unchanged).
